services.desc: Tandem jumping has been around since the early 80's. It is about the EASIEST way to do that "First Jump". With the training, preparation, aircraft ride, jump, and video dubbing, you should plan on being here for about 1/2 a day. Usually, we will have you on your way home in 2-3

services.name: Learn To Skydive
services.desc: Ground Course Your 5 hour ground course includes instruction about the gear you will use, aircraft and exit procedures, freefall body position and altitude awareness, canopy control and landing techniques, as well as emergency proceedure
